title: Andrej Karpathy — “We’re summoning ghosts, not building animals”
summary: Dwarkesh Patel interviews Andrej Karpathy on why reinforcement learning is flawed, why AGI may blend into steady GDP growth, why self-driving took so long, and the future of education. The conversation runs about two and a half hours.
why: Mostly cited as a source for Karpathy's views on agents, AGI timelines and LLMs, rather than recommended outright.

quote.text: I just watched this recent (and great!) interview
